steps.say: The magnitude is the length of the arrow from the origin to its tip, which is the hypotenuse of a right triangle on the two components: $|\langle x, y \rangle| = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}$.
The components square to [[x2]] and [[y2]], and squaring is what makes their signs irrelevant.
The squares add to [[sum]], which is a perfect square, so the root comes out exact.
